components.name: ActivityItem
components.args: title, time?, category?, location?, duration?, note?, action?, done?, onRemove?, weight?, accessibility?

props.name: title
props.description: What it is, e.g. 'Prado Museum'.

props.name: time
props.description: Start time as a display string, e.g. '10:00'.

props.name: category
props.description: Drives the icon and colour the host uses.

props.name: location
props.description: Where it happens, e.g. 'Paseo del Prado 23'.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long to budget, e.g. '2h'.

props.name: note
props.description: One short practical note, e.g. 'Book the timed entry'.

props.name: action
props.description: Fired when the traveler taps the activity.

props.name: done
props.description: Whether the traveler has ticked this off.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Fired when the traveler drops this activity. Give every activity one: a day plan is theirs to edit.

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

props.name: accessibility
props.description: Assistive technology: {label, description, live, hidden}.

components.express: root = ActivityItem("Prado Museum", "10:00", category="sight", location="Paseo del Prado 23", duration="2h", note="Book the timed entry")
components.description: A single scheduled thing inside an ItineraryDay — a meal, a museum, a transfer, a check-in.

components.name: AirportPicker
components.args: label, value, options, kind?, placeholder?, weight?, accessibility?, checks?

props.name: label
props.description: The question, e.g. 'Where from?'.

props.name: value
props.description: Bound path the chosen option's `value` is written to, e.g. `$/trip/origin`.

props.name: options
props.description: Every place that may be chosen. Static values only.

props.name: kind
props.description: Which end of the trip this is; sets the icon.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint in the empty field, e.g. 'City or airport'.

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

props.name: accessibility
props.description: Assistive technology: {label, description, live, hidden}.

components.express:
$/trip/origin = "JFK"
root = AirportPicker("Where from?", $/trip/origin, [{value: "JFK", label: "New York", code: "JFK", detail: "North America"}, {value: "CPH", label: "Copenhagen", code: "CPH", detail: "Europe"}, {value: "SFO", label: "San Francisco", code: "SFO", detail: "North America"}], kind="origin", placeholder="City or airport")
components.description: A search field for one place — where the trip leaves from or goes to — with a type-ahead list of the places this deployment serves. Use it for an origin or a destination; never a ChoicePicker of airports.

components.name: AudioPlayer

props.name: description

props.name: weight

components.name: Button
components.args: child, variant?, action, weight?, checks?

props.name: child
props.description: The ID of the child component. Use a 'Text' component for a labeled button. Only use an 'Icon' if the requirements explicitly ask for an icon-only button.

props.name: variant
props.description: A hint for the button style. If omitted, a default button style is used. 'primary' indicates this is the main call-to-action button. 'borderless' means the button has no visual border or background, making its child content appear like a clickable link.

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

components.express:
face = Text("Search flights")
root = Button(face, action=Event("search_flights"), variant="primary")

components.name: Card

props.name: child
props.description: The ID of the single child component to be rendered inside the card. To display multiple elements, you MUST wrap them in a layout component (like Column or Row) and pass that container's ID here. Do NOT pass multiple IDs or a non-existent ID.

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

components.express:
inner = Text("Anything can go in a card.")
root = Card(inner)

components.text: Anything can go in a card.

props.description: The current state of the checkbox (true for checked, false for unchecked).

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

components.express: root = CheckBox("I need somewhere to stay in Chicago", $/stops/1/needsStay)

components.label: I need somewhere to stay in Chicago

components.name: ChoicePicker
components.args: label?, variant?, options, value, displayStyle?, filterable?, weight?, checks?

props.name: label
props.description: The label for the group of options.

props.name: variant
props.description: A hint for how the choice picker should be displayed and behave.

props.name: options
props.description: The list of available options to choose from.

props.name: value
props.description: The list of currently selected values. This should be bound to a string array in the data model.

props.name: displayStyle
props.description: The display style of the component.

props.name: filterable

props.name: weight

components.name: Column
components.args: children, justify?, align?, weight?

props.name: children
props.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list. Children cannot be defined inline, they must be referred to by ID.

props.name: justify
props.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (vertically). Use 'spaceBetween' to push items to the edges (e.g. header at top, footer at bottom), or 'start'/'end'/'center' to pack them together.

props.name: align
props.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (horizontally). This is similar to the CSS 'align-items' property.

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

components.express:
a = Text("#### Outbound")
b = Text("JFK → MAD · Sun 12 Apr")
root = Column([a, b], align="stretch")
components.description: A layout component that arranges its children vertically. To create a grid layout, nest Rows within this Column.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.args: label, start, end, action?, nightsLabel?, weight?, accessibility?, checks?

props.name: label
props.description: What the range is for, e.g. 'When are you going?'.

props.name: start
props.description: Bound path for the start date (yyyy-MM-dd).

props.name: end
props.description: Bound path for the end date (yyyy-MM-dd).

props.name: action
props.description: Fired when the traveler commits a new range.

props.name: nightsLabel
props.description: Derived caption, e.g. '6 nights'.

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

props.name: accessibility
props.description: Assistive technology: {label, description, live, hidden}.

components.express:
$/trip/startDate = "2027-04-12"
$/trip/endDate = "2027-04-19"
root = DateRangePicker("Trip dates", $/trip/startDate, $/trip/endDate, nightsLabel=formatString("${calcNights(start: ${/trip/startDate}, end: ${/trip/endDate})} nights"))
components.description: Picks the trip's start and end dates. Both bound values are ISO 8601 calendar dates with no time or offset, e.g. '2026-04-12'.

components.name: DateTimeInput
components.args: label, value, enableDate?, enableTime?, min?, max?, weight?, checks?

props.name: label
props.description: The text label for the input field.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected date and/or time value in ISO 8601 format. If not yet set, initialize with an empty string.

props.name: enableDate
props.description: If true, allows the user to select a date.

props.name: enableTime
props.description: If true, allows the user to select a time.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format.

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

components.express:
$/trip/startDate = "2027-04-12"
root = DateTimeInput("Departure", $/trip/startDate, enableDate=true)

props.description: The orientation of the divider.

props.name: title
props.description: What was paid for, e.g. 'Dinner at Sobrino'.

props.name: total
props.description: Preformatted total, e.g. '€96'.

props.name: participants
props.description: Who is splitting it. Static values only.

props.name: action
props.description: Fired when the traveler settles or edits the split.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label for that action, e.g. 'Settle up'.

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

props.name: accessibility
props.description: Assistive technology: {label, description, live, hidden}.

components.name: FlightOption
components.args: airline, departTime, arriveTime, origin, destination, price, action, duration?, stops?, flightNumber?, cabin?, selected?, badge?, total?, weight?, accessibility?

props.name: airline
props.description: Operating carrier, e.g. 'Iberia' or 'Delta'.

props.name: departTime
props.description: Local departure time as a display string, e.g. '07:15'.

props.name: arriveTime
props.description: Local arrival time as a display string. Append '+1' when the flight lands on the next day, e.g. '19:40 +1'.

props.name: origin
props.description: Origin airport code, e.g. 'JFK'.

props.name: destination
props.description: Destination airport code, e.g. 'MAD'.

props.name: price
props.description: Preformatted price including currency, e.g. '$412'.

props.name: action
props.description: Fired when the traveler selects this flight. Required — an unselectable option is not an interface.

props.name: duration
props.description: Total travel time as a display string, e.g. '7h 25m'.

props.name: stops
props.description: Stop summary, e.g. 'Nonstop' or '1 stop · LIS'.

props.name: flightNumber
props.description: Marketing flight number, e.g. 'IB6250'.

props.name: cabin
props.description: Cabin the price refers to.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether this option is currently chosen. Bind it to the data model so the selection survives a re-render.

props.name: badge
props.description: Short editorial tag, e.g. 'Cheapest' or 'Fastest'.

props.name: total
props.description: What this flight costs for everyone on this leg, when that is more than one person — preformatted, e.g. '$522 for 2'. Give it whenever the leg carries a party, and `price` is then read as the per-traveler fare.

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

props.name: accessibility
props.description: Assistive technology: {label, description, live, hidden}.

components.express: root = FlightOption("Iberia", "18:40", "08:15 +1", "JFK", "MAD", "$412", Event("select_flight", {id: "IB6252"}), duration="7h 35m", stops="Nonstop", flightNumber="IB6252", cabin="economy", badge="Cheapest")
components.description: A single selectable flight itinerary leg. Use one per option when presenting a choice of flights; do not build flight rows by hand out of Row and Text.

components.name: GoogleMap
components.args: center, zoom, tilt?, heading?, mode?, anchorMarker?, markers?, origin?, destination?, travelMode?, routes?, weight?, accessibility?

props.name: center
props.description: Where the map is centred.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How close in. 4 spans a continent, 11 a city, 14 a neighbourhood, 16 a street. Above 16 is clamped.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Degrees of tilt. Only has an effect in satellite mode.

props.name: heading
props.description: Compass heading, in degrees.

props.name: mode
props.description: Map style. Leave it alone unless somebody asks to see the terrain: a road map is what people read a decision off, and satellite imagery is beautiful and hard to compare two places on.

props.name: anchorMarker
props.description: The one place this map is about, marked apart from the rest.

props.name: markers
props.description: Pins to drop. Static list — write them out.

props.name: origin
props.description: Start of a single route.

props.name: destination
props.description: End of a single route.

props.name: travelMode
props.description: How the route is travelled.

props.name: routes
props.description: Several legs at once, drawn end to end.

props.name: weight
props.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

props.name: accessibility
props.description: Assistive technology: {label, description, live, hidden}.

components.express: root = GoogleMap(center={lat: 40.4168, lng: -3.7038}, zoom=12, markers=[{lat: 40.4260, lng: -3.7040, label: "Malasaña"}, {lat: 40.4110, lng: -3.7100, label: "La Latina"}, {lat: 40.4153, lng: -3.6844, label: "Retiro Park"}])
components.description: A real Google map, for decisions that are about distance: which stay to pick given what is near it, whether a multi-city order makes sense, how far a day's walking really is. It draws nothing and asks nothing, so pair it with the controls for the decision it illustrates — and do not use it to confirm a destination, which is a question nobody asked.

functions.name: formatDate

props.name: value
props.description: The date to format.

props.name: format
props.description:
A Unicode TR35 date pattern string.

Token Reference:
- Year: 'yy' (26), 'yyyy' (2026)
- Month: 'M' (1), 'MM' (01), 'MMM' (Jan), 'MMMM' (January)
- Day: 'd' (1), 'dd' (01), 'E' (Tue), 'EEEE' (Tuesday)
- Hour (12h): 'h' (1-12), 'hh' (01-12) - requires 'a' for AM/PM
- Hour (24h): 'H' (0-23), 'HH' (00-23) - Military Time
- Minute: 'mm' (00-59)
- Second: 'ss' (00-59)
- Period: 'a' (AM/PM)

Examples:
- 'MMM dd, yyyy' -> 'Jan 16, 2026'
- 'HH:mm' -> '14:30' (Military)
- 'h:mm a' -> '2:30 PM'
- 'EEEE, d MMMM' -> 'Friday, 16 January'

functions.description: Formats a timestamp into a string using a pattern.

functions.description: Performs string interpolation of data model values and other functions in the catalog functions list and returns the resulting string. The value string can contain interpolated expressions in the `${expression}` format. Supported expression types include: JSON Pointer paths to the data model (e.g., `${/absolute/path}` or `${relative/path}`), and renderer-side function calls (e.g., `${now()}`). Function arguments must be named (e.g., `${formatDate(value:${/currentDate}, format:'MM-dd')}`). To include a literal `${` sequence, escape it as `\${`.
